properties.site-address: Land At Chapel Hill Kingsclere Road Basingstoke
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: Outline planning permission granted for 578 units (14/00865/OUT) in January 2015. Reserved matters consent for the full 578 units (15/03667/RES) was granted in May 2016. Work has commenced on site and the first 12 units were completed in 2016/17 and 115 in 2017/18 and 132 in 2018/19. 56 of the units are to be delivered in the existing 'white building' and an application to increase this to 96 units (17/02279/FUL) was granted in March 2018. The site is deliverable within five years.
